verdict.rationale: Stripe (the platform) documents an official MCP server and CLI (stripe-tax-probe-4, stripe-tax-probe-5) plus an llms.txt for docs discovery, which are the building blocks for AI-agent/natural-language operation, but none of the evidence shows these specifically exposing Stripe Tax's calculation/filing/registration workflows via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: tax-specific MCP tool examples, natural-language usage documentation for Tax operations, and independent confirmation of AI-agent control over tax settings.
